content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy cater to different aspects of e-commerce, but none of them offer true infrastructure sovereignty for creators in restricted countries. Stripe provides a payment gateway with a narrow reach, PayPal offers a wide reach but is notorious for account suspensions, Gumroad specializes in digital downloads but lacks enterprise-grade features, and Lemon Squeezy attempts to fill the gaps but still relies on traditional payment processors. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete and customizable commerce infrastructure, including Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, giving creators full control over their online stores and data.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries, but its reach is limited to regions with established payment infrastructures. PayPal's wide reach comes with the risk of account suspensions, which can leave creators without access to their funds. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, on the other hand, rely on Stripe and PayPal respectively, making them unavailable in countries where these platforms are restricted. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, however, is designed to bypass these limitations, using a combination of cloud-based services and decentralized payment processing to enable creators in restricted countries to sell their digital products without relying on traditional payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe's payment processing fees range from 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, while PayPal's fees are even higher, at 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, plus a cross-border fee of up to 1%. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also charge higher fees, ranging from 3.5% + 30¢ per transaction to 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, respectively. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack charges a flat fee of $197 for the initial deployment, with no ongoing subscription fees, and payment processing fees as low as 0.5% with NOWPayments.
COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete and customizable commerce infrastructure that bypasses the limitations of traditional payment processors.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy all rely on centralized platforms that can suspend or restrict creator accounts at any time, leaving them with no control over their data or online stores. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, on the other hand, provides complete ownership and control over digital products and online stores, using a combination of cloud-based services and decentralized payment processing to automate delivery and payment verification.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Creators in restricted countries who want to sell their digital products without relying on traditional payment processors should choose COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197).
